name: io.github.theluckystrike/fema-disaster-declarations-aid-mcp
title: FEMA Disaster Declarations & Aid MCP
description: US federal disaster declarations, county eligibility, and FEMA Individual/Public Assistance totals.

tools.name: fema_disaster_search
tools.description: Search US federally declared disasters by state, incident type (Hurricane, Flood, Severe Storm, Fire, Tornado, Earthquake, etc.), declaration type (DR = Major Disaster, EM = Emergency, FM = Fire Management), keyword in title, or year range. Returns disaster numbers, dates, declared assistance programs, and FEMA.gov links.

state.description: 2-letter US state/territory code or full name, e.g. "FL", "TX", "California".

declaration_type.description: DR (Major Disaster), EM (Emergency), or FM (Fire Management).

keyword.description: Keyword in the disaster name, e.g. "Milton", "Helene", "Wildfire".

tools.name: fema_county_disaster_check
tools.description: Check federal disaster declarations designating a specific US county, parish, or borough (by state + county name, or 5-digit county FIPS code). Returns declaration IDs (e.g. DR-4955-FL), incident types, dates, declared assistance programs (IHP, IA, PA, HMGP), and Individual Assistance filing deadlines.

state.description: 2-letter US state code or full state name (required unless fips is given).

county.description: County, parish, or borough name, e.g. "Miami-Dade", "Harris", "Buncombe".

fips.description: 5-digit county FIPS code (2-digit state + 3-digit county), e.g. "12086".

tools.name: fema_disaster_aid_summary
tools.description: Retrieve official FEMA federal aid totals and designated counties for a specific disaster number (e.g. 4834): Individual Assistance approvals, Individuals & Households Program (IHP) approved dollars, Housing Assistance, Other Needs Assistance, Public Assistance obligated dollars (emergency work vs permanent work), Hazard Mitigation Grant Program funding, and designated areas.

disaster_number.description: Numeric FEMA disaster number, e.g. 4834 or 4955.

tools.name: fema_recent_disasters
tools.description: List the newest US federal disaster declarations nationwide or for a specific state, sorted newest first, with incident types, declaration dates, declared aid programs, and FEMA.gov links.

state.description: Optional 2-letter US state code or full name.
